name: Corn & Soybeans: Extreme Backwardation Regime Analysis
description: Three-way term structure regime analysis for corn (ZC) and soybeans (ZS) futures. Normalizes carry spread as % of price and splits into: Extreme Backwardation (carry >5% of price), Mild Backwardation (0-5%), and Contango (<0%). Tests whether extreme backwardation predicts the next quarter's (63-day) forward price return. Uses LiquidityBased rollover with NoAdjustment for meaningful spread values.
source:
# Corn & Soybeans: Extreme Backwardation Regime Analysis
# Carry normalized as % of price → three regimes:
#   Extreme Backwardation: carry_pct > 5%
#   Mild Backwardation:    0% < carry_pct <= 5%
#   Contango:              carry_pct <= 0%
# Forward 63-day price return tests whether extreme backwardation predicts next quarter

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
carry = cont.carry
ts = index()

# --- Normalize carry as % of price ---
carry_pct = carry / close

# --- Three-Way Regime Classification ---
is_extreme_back = is_valid(carry_pct) and carry_pct > 0.05
is_mild_back = is_valid(carry_pct) and carry_pct > 0 and carry_pct <= 0.05
is_contango = is_valid(carry_pct) and carry_pct <= 0

# --- Forward 63-Day Price Return ---
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(close)

# Regime-filtered forward returns
fwd_extreme = where(is_extreme_back, fwd_63d)
fwd_mild = where(is_mild_back, fwd_63d)
fwd_contango = where(is_contango, fwd_63d)

# Hit rates (ternary for correct Mean = hit rate)
hit_extreme = where(is_extreme_back, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_mild = where(is_mild_back, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)
hit_contango = where(is_contango, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_63d) and fwd_63d > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Regime Flip Detection (into/out of extreme backwardation) ---
prev_extreme = is_extreme_back >> 1
flip_into_extreme = is_extreme_back and (not prev_extreme)
flip_out_of_extreme = (not is_extreme_back) and prev_extreme
any_extreme_flip = flip_into_extreme or flip_out_of_extreme
flip_direction_label = conditional_select(flip_into_extreme, 1.0, flip_out_of_extreme, -1.0, 0.0)

# --- Carry % area fill for regime visualization ---
carry_extreme = where(is_extreme_back, carry_pct)
carry_mild = where(is_mild_back, carry_pct)
carry_contango = where(is_contango, carry_pct)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT: 1 category, 3 charts + event markers
# ============================================================

# 1. CONTEXT — Carry % time series with three regime bands
xy_lines(
    title='Carry as % of Price: Three Regimes',
    category='Term Structure Regime',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Extreme Backwardation (>5%)', color=Color.Blue, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Mild Backwardation (0-5%)', color=Color.Sky, area=True),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Contango (<0%)', color=Color.Gray, area=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Flat'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.05, color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='5% Threshold')
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Carry / Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(carry_extreme, carry_mild, carry_contango))

# 2. PUNCHLINE — Median forward 63d return by regime (three bars)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Extreme Backwardation Predict Higher Returns?',
    category='Term Structure Regime',
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Extreme Back (>5%)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Mild Back (0-5%)', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Contango', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_extreme, fwd_mild, fwd_contango))

# 3. REFERENCE — Summary table: N, Median, Hit Rate, Best, Worst per regime
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Term Structure Regime',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='63-Day Forward Return by Regime',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Obs Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (>0)', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        col_headers=['Extreme Back (>5%)', 'Mild Back (0-5%)', 'Contango'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(fwd_extreme, fwd_mild, fwd_contango, fwd_extreme, fwd_mild, fwd_contango, hit_extreme, hit_mild, hit_contango, fwd_extreme, fwd_mild, fwd_contango, fwd_extreme, fwd_mild, fwd_contango)

# 4. EVENT MAP — Extreme backwardation regime flip markers
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Backwardation Flip',
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry %', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(carry_pct, flip_direction_label, close, any_extreme_flip)
